synth.notes:
Kick/slide token game, frame output. Player moves 3 per step and is blocked by frame colours 2/15 or the portal bbox. A next rect that overlaps blocks kicks them (player stays): they slide as a closed push chain, 3 cells per tick, until a member hits colour 2, the bound, the player, or the interior of a socket it does not fit.
New rim stop: a sliding block stops once its leading edge reaches a rim line (bbox edge row/col) of a socket it fits exactly. This explains step 101 (token_0 3x6 stops at y15, the bottom rim row of socket_11_10). Ablating it fails only step 101.
Click on a block: the player takes its rect and the old player stays as an inert husk (rim 14, centre 4). Sprites: rim 14 with centre 5 (blocks) or 0 (player), and each player edge touching a block is drawn all 0.
HUD row 63 = ceil(n/2) zeros from the right, n = actions this level. The parity is hidden, so n is kept across calls only while the incoming frame matches the last returned one; otherwise n = 2z-1. Background un
